title: Each test file of Assuring belongs to one documented suite
when: Reads each file that an automated test record of ST-ASR names and finds its suite, as go test ./... of its Go module or scripts/run-python-tests.py; then reads each test file of their packages for each Getenv or LookupEnv of a STEGO_ variable, follows the name that the value is assigned to, and finds a test that fails, skips or returns when the variable is not set, which no test of the tree sets.
then: Expects README.md to document go test ./..., each test file to belong to exactly one suite, and the section "The environment of the tests" of README.md to name each such variable as a whole word, unless the test lists it as an opt-in variable. Names each file that breaks this.
notes: The test number is the domain's position (ST-ASR 1 to ST-SUP 8). It reads the automated test records of the domain in the pinned lathe check --json, the files they name and the other test files of their packages, from the git objects at HEAD. A variable counts as named only as a whole word in the section "The environment of the tests" of README.md.
